title: Pension Benefits Standards Act
verified_how: Browsed the CiviX P directory: 'Pension Benefits Standards Act [SBC 2012] c. 30' has document ID 00_12030. Fetching that document shows 'Pension Benefits Standards Act [SBC 2012] CHAPTER 30 Assented to May 31, 2012' and says it is current to September 15, 2026. The older RSBC 1996, c. 352 (96352_01) page states it was 'Repealed by the Pension Benefits Standards Act, SBC 2012, c. 30, s. 134, effective September 30, 2015'.
notes: Regulates private employment pension plans registered in BC. The CPP and OAS (public social security) are federal.
